title: Generators of the strict tensor tower after quotient transport
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme W. For arbitrary integral complexes P,Q and coefficient sequence complexes C,D, let a,b identify their reference ordinary reductions with C,D. Suppose evaluating a,b and then kappaC,kappaD gives the inverse reference finite evaluation [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations]. Restrict and evaluate the total tensor of a inverse and b inverse, and compose it with the reference strict tensor-tower comparison. This explicit strict tower isomorphism sends every local homogeneous tensor generator, in every pair of degrees and quotient level, to the finite total tensor generator of the sections evaluated and then mapped by kappaC,kappaD [def-pur-scalar-extension-tower-data]. No derived coherence or K-flatness is required for this ordinary calculation.

proof.text: Use naturality of restriction/evaluation and tensor evaluation to identify the level map with the finite total tensor of kappaC,kappaD. Cancel the evaluated strict isomorphisms using the assumed normalization equations.

Restriction/evaluation preserves the represented section. The tensor evaluation comparison sends a homogeneous generator to the generator of the evaluated sections. Mapping the finite total tensor applies the two component maps to those sections, giving the asserted formula.

lean.statement:
theorem strictQuotientTensorGenerator (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules.{u, u} l E W) ℤ)
    (C D : Complex l E W)
    (a : (((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≅ C)
    (b : (((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≅ D)
    (κC : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E W n).obj P)
    (κD : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D ≅
        (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E W n).obj Q)
    (ha : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapIso a ≪≫
        κC n = ((pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E W n).app P).symm)
    (hb : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapIso b ≪≫
        κD n = ((pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E W n).app Q).symm) :
    let F := (coefficientSequenceRestriction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex
    let q := F.mapIso ((tensor l E W).mapIso (a.symm.prod b.symm)) ≪≫
      pullbackTensorTensorTower l E W P Q
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (p r : ℤ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : (C.X p).val.obj (op (n, U.unop)))
      (y : (D.X r).val.obj (op (n, U.unop))),
      ((q.hom.app (op n)).f (p + r)).val.app U
        (integralComparisonRestrictedSection l E W
          (((tensor l E W).obj (C, D)).X (p + r)) n U
          (generator l E W C D p r (op (n, U.unop)) x y)) =
        integralTensorGenerator l E W P Q n p r U
          (((κC n).hom.f p).val.app U
            (coefficientEvaluationSection l E W (C.X p) n U x))
          (((κD n).hom.f r).val.app U
            (coefficientEvaluationSection l E W (D.X r) n U y))
